outcome.technical: One record-path definition now lives in plugins/audit/scripts/governance/_invariants.py: record_rels(manifest_path, phase, project, git_root, head_index=None, config=None) returns, once each and in order, the index, this phase's file, every shard the working index names, every shard head_index names, the journal dir and the evidence dir (paths outside git_root are left out, via _invariants._rel). is_record_path(path, records) is the membership test, built on _under (_task_outputs.covers): the path itself or anything under it, never a sibling that only shares a prefix. _shard_files moved there from integrate-task. _invariants gained no import (it already had _journal_io, _evidence_io and _mio), so _deps.LAYERS is unchanged, and no hook imports _invariants (grep -rln 'import _invariants' plugins/audit/hooks exit 1), so bench-hooks was not owed. Callers: integrate-task.record_paths delegates to it with head_index unchanged (_index_at still reads HEAD) and its three _is_record uses call _invariants.is_record_path. Its private _is_record and _shard_files are removed. _journal_io stays imported with noqa F401 because test_integrate_task.py:168 reads M._journal_io, and I may not edit that file. audit-task._record_rels is now a one-line wrapper (it binds git_root_for), its _is_record_path is removed and both uses call the shared predicate. The comment block now says the definition is in _invariants, and the --files refusal now names the manifest index too. In commit-task-work.stage_targets, a declared entry at or under a carried record (the phase file, the journal dir, the evidence dir) is dropped from the declared list and travels with the record. A declared entry that is any other record (the sharded index, another phase's shard) is dropped from declared and named in `skipped`; the index is still staged only through the bug-link rule. Tests: test_commit_task_work.py has a new dr-block of 3 cases (journal file + shard + index not declared; index and sibling shard passed over by name; an ALLOW case where declared == [src/a.py]). test__invariants.py has a new rp-block of 7 cases (the exact set with a HEAD-only sibling shard; integrate-task's record_paths equals it; audit-task's _record_rels equals the working-index set; commit-task-work declares only non-record entries; the predicate admits records and paths under them; DENY: src/a.py, journal-notes/, an unnamed shard P9 and audit-plan.json.bak are not records; no caller keeps its own predicate). Red before the fix: ctw 117/120 with all 3 dr cases failing on assertions, inv 124/130 with 6 failing (the integrate pin passed because that behaviour already existed). After the fix: ctw 120/120, inv 130/130, integrate 30/30, audit-task 1045/1045. Mutation probes ran on full scratch copies, never the shared tree: is_record_path exact-only gave inv 128/130 and ctw 118/120; always-True gave inv 128/130 and ctw 88/120; dropping the head_index shards gave inv 128/130. Full sweep exit 0 (335/335 files, 16409 cases). The cp1252 pass exited 0 (335/335 files ok, both halves ran); it prints 0 cases per file in that mode.
outcome.descriptive: audit-task, commit-task-work and integrate-task now share one answer to which paths are records, so a declared journal file, phase shard or the sharded index is no longer refused as a task's own work.
